categories.title: Language Learning
categories.description: Tools and platforms for language acquisition

resources.title: Duolingo
resources.description: Free language learning app with gamified lessons
resources.summary: Popular mobile-first platform offering bite-sized lessons in 40+ languages. Great for beginners with its game-like progression system.

resources.title: Anki
resources.summary: Powerful flashcard app using spaced repetition algorithm. Highly customizable with user-generated decks. Best for vocabulary memorization.

resources.title: Forvo
resources.summary: World's largest pronunciation dictionary. Hear words pronounced by native speakers from around the globe. Essential for proper pronunciation.

resources.title: Linguee
resources.summary: Context-based translation tool showing how words are used in real documents. Great for understanding nuances and professional usage.

resources.title: Vatican Digital Library
resources.description: Digitized manuscripts from the Vatican Library
resources.summary: Access to thousands of historical manuscripts, including medieval codices, illuminated texts, and ancient documents. High-resolution images available.
